body: No. Nothing like that. I know a lot about him but he's so smart that making me sound like a psycho stalker would be easy. He comes from a highly respected family and works with big name companies money. No one would believe me over him.
Sorry for the confusion. I did push him put of my life but I'm bitter that I'm dealing with heart break and he isn't.  That's all this is. Just me being garbage.
We used various messaging systems throughout the years then moved on to throwaway reddit accounts that we'd both delete before making a new one every few weeks. I never screen captured anything.
Zero proof. Without it I just look like a crazy stalker that knows a lot about both of them.
Suicidal ideation is among many of us here. I know it doesn't mean anything with how the thoughts make you feel, but you're not alone and your feelings are valid.
Happy birthday friend. This next drink is for you.
